title: Perturbation of monic matrix polynomials
summary: In this paper, we study the stability of matrix polynomials under structured perturbations of their coefficients. More precisely, we consider a family of matrix polynomials \[ P_u(λ)=A_d(u)λ^d+A_{d-1}(u)λ^{d-1}+\cdots+A_0(u), \] whose matrix coefficients depend continuously and semialgebraically on a parameter vector $u\in\mathbb{C}^p$.
